_comment: Grouped Optuna search over the 5 BioProject-disjoint dev folds. Identical budget and search space for the multi-task arm and every single-task control, so the comparison is best-vs-best.

class_imbalance._comment: tau is SEARCHED in [0.05, 0.8]. tau=1.0, the parameter-free default, over-corrects at this imbalance: dev fold 2 single-task `feature` scored 0.009 at tau=1.0 against 0.484 at tau=0.25.

masking._comment: Absent labels are masked, not encoded as a class. Environmental runs have no community_type/sample_host; host runs have no feature; material classes under 3 training runs are masked; 12 McDonough2018 runs have conflicting labels masked per target.
